source.description: Twelve recorded investigations of six Linkding captures. Source: the second post-fix study documented in docs/experiments/linkding-comparison.md. All upstream tests passed.
source.projection: Preserves verdicts, retrieved evidence, initial state, model choices, timings and trace links. Repeated prompt state, questions and scoring labels are omitted. No new model calls.
source.scope: One archive workflow, two controls and four injected mutations; not an independent production benchmark.

requirements: Retain the existing bookmark and set is_archived to true.
Update date_modified and save the bookmark; preserve its other stored fields.
Preserve all other bookmarks, including those owned by other users; only the requested bookmark is saved.
Preserve tags and bookmark/tag associations; this operation does not remove them.

source.implementation: Sets is_archived = True, sets date_modified = timezone.now(), saves, and returns the bookmark.
